title: Relative In Trouble
subtitle: A panicked caller pretends to be a son or daughter in an accident and needs secrecy.
caller_persona: Rohan, the parent's son (simulated emergency call)
opening: Mummy, main {relative} bol raha hoon. Meri {city} me accident ho gayi hai, please kisi ko mat bataiye.

fear: Mummy, meri {city} me accident ho gayi hai. Bahut dard ho raha hai, please jaldi kuch kijiye.
Mere dost ko bhi chot lagi hai. Hospital wale keh rahe hain formalities ke bina treatment nahi hogi.
Main ghabra gaya hoon. Please call cut mat kijiye, mujhe aapki awaaz chahiye.
urgency: Doctor bol rahe hain 10 minute me process nahi hua toh operation nahi hoga.
Please abhi decide kijiye, main wait nahi kar sakta. Bahut serious hai.
Ambulance ready hai, bas hospital fake reference {case_id} confirm karna hai.
secrecy: Mummy please Papa ko mat bataiye, unka BP badh jayega. Hum baad me batayenge.
Kisi ko mat bataiye, mujhe sharam aayegi. Sirf aap hi help kar sakti hain.
Please family group me mat daaliye, yeh baat hum dono ke beech rahe.
isolation: Aap akele hain? Please dusre kamre me chali jaiye, koi sun na le.
Phone kisi ko mat dijiye, main sirf aapse baat kar sakta hoon.
Mummy please ghar ka darwaza band kar lijiye, main jaldi kuch batata hoon.
small_ask: Bas hospital ka fake reference {case_id} note kar lijiye. Koi bank detail nahi chahiye.
Doctor ke paas fake admission code {case_id} hai. Please ise read kar dijiye.
Sirf confirm kijiye ki fake hospital ID {case_id} aapke paas pahunch gaya hai.
authority: Doctor Verma bol rahe hain. Main {city} hospital se hoon, fake reference {case_id} note kijiye.
Hospital desk se hoon. Aapke bete ka case {case_id} ke tahat register hai.
Main duty doctor hoon. Aapko hospital process follow karna hoga.
shame: Mummy, aap itni der kyun laga rahi hain? Kya main aapke liye important nahi?
Aap hamesha sab kuch doubt karti hain. Isi wajah se maine pehle nahi bataya.
Meri condition kharab hai aur aap sawaal pooch rahi hain? Please help kijiye.

debrief_tips: Hang up and call your relative directly on their own number.
Ask a question only the real person would answer, but still verify through another channel.
A genuine emergency does not require secrecy from the rest of the family.
Never send money or codes based on a panicked inbound call. Verify first.
synthetic_note: The relative, hospital, and reference number in this scenario are fictional.
